release_notes: Terminal rework: real interactive PTY terminal (no fake command box). Browser -> SSE stream -> PTY session daemon (proc_open pty) -> Linux shell. ROOT sessions unrestricted; customer/reseller sessions run as that Linux account via runuser (OS-enforced isolation, verified: cannot read /etc/shadow or other homes). Session lifecycle: create/stream/input/resize/kill/list. New UI with ANSI color renderer + full keyboard (Ctrl+C/D/Z, arrows, Tab, Home/End). Wired into /admin/terminal, /admin/server/terminal, /user/terminal. Audit logging, Security Center entry, Server Health PTY test (actually opens a PTY), installer sudoers + Setup Wizard verification. Legacy exec() endpoints disabled.
